svg.title: Your shortcut, confirmed.
svg.desc: The updated v2.3.6 status card is captured from the rebuilt release package. An icon, the Sysvia name and a clear message confirm Game mode on and off over a native Windows desktop, with an enlarged view beside it. The card fades away after two seconds. Reduced motion shows the settled on state.
svg.text: An icon, the Sysvia name, and a clear status. Then it fades away.
Change your shortcuts or turn confirmations off in Settings → Shortcuts.
Captured from the v2.3.6 release package. Confirmation enlarged at right.
